question: According to the latest international work policy, how many consecutive days can an employee work from another country?

thought: I need to find the latest international work policy to determine the maximum number of consecutive days an employee can work from another country. I will search for this information.

[DOC0101 v2.0 2026-09-01] (score=0.747) ## Section 8.1: Maximum Duration and Approval (v2.0)

This policy version 2.0 (DOC0101, effective 2026-09-01) supersedes DOC0005 v1.0. Employees may work from a company office in another country for up to 21 consecutive days (reduced from 30 days in v1.0). International work requires prior approval from both the line manager and the HR business partner.
[DOC0101 v2.0 2026-09-01] (score=0.589) ## Section 8.2: Submission Lead Time and Documentation (v2.0)

Under version 2.0 (DOC0101), a request to work from another country (INTL_WORK) must be submitted at least 15 business days in advance of the start date (increased from 10 business days in DOC0005 v1.0). The request must state the destination country, the local office, the start and end dates, and the business reason.

final_answer: According to the latest international work policy (DOC0101 v2.0, effective 2026-09-01), an employee can work from another country for up to **21 consecutive days**. This limit was reduced from 30 days in the previous version (DOC0005 v1.0). Any stay exceeding 21 days requires additional approval from the department head and a tax review [DOC0101].
